notes.title: Short Weekly Update #115
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, fellow entrepreneurs! 🤗⭐[/p][p]We are not releasing a new update today, as many of the changes and additions below require thorough testing. A small number of fixes and quality improvements have been applied in the game and will come out next week, and we've also made big progress on Achievements, which led to cloud saves being activated.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]There are only 100 achievements which we were able to add due to current Steam limits; Steam still treats this game as a 'fake game'. Therefore, we cannot go above 100 at the moment. Cloud saving is now enabled for achievement progress to sync across devices.[/p][/*][*][p]We implemented some minor balancing this week, such as marketing cost was reduced by 50% to make early promotion more accessible and to prepare for AI competition. Additionally, we increased the vehicle upgrade capacity. Every vehicle gained one extra upgrade slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Cold storage upgrade was streamlined. Now you can upgrade directly to the next tier; no need to buy an extra storage and sell the old one as previously required. [/p][/*][/list][h3]New features and improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Research UI now shows progress on tier titles and on each category header, so players do not get stuck if they miss a research in a tier.[/p][/*][*][p]In the News section, the missing "Okay" button that was supposed to appear to acknowledge the event is now back, giving you enough time to read. Sorry, that was missed last time. And now the auto-advance option is available for those who prefer it.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Input fallback was added to reset held-keys when a key-release is missed. According to a community bug report: ordering is always changing by 5x. This aims to resolve that odd behaviour.[/p][/*][*][p]Cash event bug fixed: A "last 7-day" protection was not blocking all cash events from repeating within a 7-day period. This was fixed. Now, within seven in-game days, only one cash event can occur, as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Cold storage capacity duplication on vehicle upgrade fixed. Thanks to the community report.[/p][/*][*][p]UI shake regression cleaned up. Repeated shakes no longer shift the UI out of place. Thanks to the community report.[/p][/*][*][p]Expiring ingredients label now updates correctly between day and night. No more confusion on the expiring ingredients. Thanks to the community report.[/p][/*][*][p]Goal Completed text and VFX formatting fixed to make the text legible on both light and dark modes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Achievements sneak peek: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/274dd02ee862fd0b05e380daf1b6fe1f80d179a9.png"][/img][/p][p]That is it for this week. As always, your reports help us tune the balance and find edge cases. Keep them coming.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Follow the journey![/b] Join our community here: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/HpDZM7v"]https://discord.gg/HpDZM7v[/url][/p][p][url="https://businessheroes.m-pages.com/GwNkYz/business-heroes-website"]https://businessheroes.m-pages.com/GwNkYz/business-heroes-website[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Live long and prosper 👋

notes.title: Short Weekly Update #114
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! ⭐🙋🏻[/p][p]Apologies for the gap in posts. Updates were paused to fix critical build bugs and complete a quality check on new mechanics. This is a significant drop that incorporates the recent changes from the past few weeks.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]We did a full review of the game’s event system with fixes across branding, economy, and probability events.[/p][/*][*][p]We revamped the End-of-Day report with performance review, new UI, and fixed localisation.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera and UI polish continues, storage overflow feedback is clearer, and tutorial guidance is sharper.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New features and improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Capacity feedback on ordering screen: storage percentage(%) now changes colour as capacity fills. Ordering tooltips now show storage capacity and warnings. A sound effect and a shake plays each time stock will go to waste due to over-capacity (120% or above). The sound is rate-limited, and only triggers from manual clicks on the Manage Ordering plus button and the Calculate button.[/p][/*][*][p]Goal completion visibility improvements: corrected text formatting in the Goal Completed effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Research guidance: a pretty big cursor tracker in the Research tab remains; the count of unlocked research is hidden to reduce clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Events tab quality of life: Esc clears the overlay after completing a news event. The overlay also clears automatically in the morning if still visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Histogram in End of Day report: Career day histogram submissions are now stored in the database for analysis and public ranking. We require at least 10 data points to rank players. Each player can save only one data point per country.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]End of Day report: what changed and why. (Special thanks to Zach Barth)[/h3][p]The goal was to turn the End of Day report into a clear performance review that rewards good play and to guide players on where to improve.[/p][p]What is new[/p][list][*][p]Performance review panels: three deep-dive views covering Price Management, Stock Management, and Customer Satisfaction. Each view includes metrics, rank, and guidance.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance ratings will be used in future versions to allocate experience points, which will then be utilized for the research tree as research boosts.[/p][/*][*][p]Milestones: confetti now celebrates milestones reached that day in the End of Day sequence.[/p][/*][*][p]Visuals and audio: themed UI applied across the new panels, popup alignment improved, progress circles animate on fill, and the “Best” mark size reduced to fit cleanly in the End of Day report.[/p][/*][/list][p]Work in progress:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/2f2a1a8676a0ee13976a96a5e1e969b6400dd311.png"][/img]Research Unlocked and Expired Ingredients are now displayed as pop-ups next to the main section of the End of Day report. The histograms at the bottom of the view will be populated once we have enough data points on the server. To help increase the data points, please invite your friends to play, as each player can contribute only one data point per country. And the system will always keep the best value for each player. Thanks to Zach Barth for the assistance in building this system.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/1bf3e8f557ddee0627b1271400862450b6ddce57.png"][/img]Customer satisfaction measures the ratio of positive feedback to negative feedback, excluding any feedback categorized as too expensive. This will keep players focused on customer satisfaction. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/2a589a038f8fd3c5fbdb60282460c66245554bcd.png"][/img]Effective price management is vital for deepening the understanding of the dynamics between demand and supply. A price survey can reveal the price customers are inclined to pay for a product; however, it overlooks the demand that this specified price will generate. Often, the demand sparked by the "desired" price point can significantly surpass the standard supply or capacity available. This section delves into this critical issue, providing guidance for players on how to strategically adjust prices. By doing so, they can attain an optimal queue size, enhancing both customer satisfaction and operational efficiency through thoughtful pricing strategies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/fe58a83372cd91f44105743076844429f9ff2048.png"][/img]Storage management is another critical factor, as players often run out of stock well before the end of the day, sometimes as early as 6 hours before closing. To encourage better storage practices, we introduced a reward system for efficient storage management. Items will only expire if you don’t have a fridge, which means that ordering enough ingredients to meet daily sales should be easy for those with a fridge. If a stand’s capacity is utilized to at least 80% of max capacity and all items are sold, players will be rewarded for effective storage management. Storage Efficiency = (Used Storage Space ÷ 80% of Total Available Storage Space), where Used Storage Space is the difference between space used at the start of the day and space used at the end of the day. [/p][p]Please give it a try and let us know what you think. [/p][p][/p][h3]Events overhaul: two-week focused pass[/h3][p]The objective was to resolve correctness, permanence, localisation, and activation order across all event.[/p][p]What was reviewed[/p][list][*][p]Appearance and population base happiness events.[/p][/*][*][p]Branding events.[/p][/*][*][p]GDP and interest rate events.[/p][/*][*][p]Cash and permit fee events.[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase probability and segment size events.[/p][/*][/list][p]Key fixes and changes[/p][list][*][p]Activation and permanence[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where only the last active event was reactivated when loading a save. Multiple permanent events are now restored correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected GDP events that should be permanent and ensured day-duration settings are added when events are non-permanent.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Clean Event function on deactivation for events that target stands or employees to avoid errors if a stand is sold during an event.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored event modifiers on deactivation, where removal could strip permanent effects incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added flags for event stages so late-game days continue with the last included stage beyond the end day.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Branding logic[/p][list][*][p]Replaced a single GlobalCompanyBrandModifier with a list that supports DistrictTypes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added utilities to resolve stand-specific and locality-specific branding.[/p][/*][*][p]Branding events can now pick a locality based on a random stand’s position for better spread.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Economy and rates[/p][list][*][p]Interest rate tooltip variables now render with the correct colours.[/p][/*][*][p]Zero-sum permanent interest events no longer show zeroed values in effects.[/p][/*][*][p]GDP events now match descriptions and timing, including fixed duration flags.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cash and fees[/p][list][*][p]Added appropriate research requirements to gate some cash events.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected names and descriptions for WonLawsuit and TrademarkInfringement.[/p][/*][*][p]Permit fee events: fixed a missing permanent flag, corrected a translation error, and repaired a tooltip variable that did not display.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Probability and segments[/p][list][*][p]Stand probability event descriptions corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Probability formatting has been fixed in tooltips, and damage numbers can be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Global and stand probability configurations aligned with the design.[/p][/*][*][p]Segment size events now include previously excluded segments, with value tweaks and recurrence fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Event test runs now respect each event’s requirements, so only applicable events are considered.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Localisation and persistence[/p][list][*][p]Fixed missing Chinese variables in event descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Permanent event descriptions now continue to show for at least one day even after leaving the News tab.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Other Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Tutorial: resolved a soft lock in the Ordering tutorial when clicking Auto Repeat research.[/p][/*][*][p]News overlay: Esc to clear after an event; auto-clear in the morning if still visible.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: sprite formatting corrected in Goal Completed text; tooltip offsets now scale with screen DPI.[/p][/*][*][p]Input: added a fallback to reset held keys if the release was missed.[/p][/*][*][p]Stand data: fixed stand financial history not loading due to sequence changes; fixed feedback bubble sorting when pooled.[/p][/*][*][p]Research progress: progress display added to tier titles and to category headers.[/p][/*][*][p]Event protection: the last 7-day cash event notes.title: Progress Update: Crafting Tasty Burger Recipes
notes.notes:
Hello Business Hero,

So glad you stopped by today. Let's dive right in. 

The recipe section is where you craft your magic burger formula for various tastes and wallets in the city. It works like a kitchen without the heat of cooking, It's up to you to decide the burger recipe and pricing for your food stand.

[b]What goes in your burger?[/b]🍔

The recipe section has five ingredients with a minimum and maximum amount you can include in your burger:

[i][b]Patty[/b][/i]: 100g - 300g per burger.

[i][b]Tomato slices[/b][/i]: 0 - 5 slices per burger.

[i][b]Lettuce leaves[/b][/i]: 0 - 5 leaves per burger.

[i][b]Cheese slices[/b][/i]: 0 - 5 slices per burger.

[i][b]Sauce[/b][/i]: 0 - 3 sachets per burger.

The unit cost of your burger will depend on the amount of ingredients you include in it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/b354912915eccf7d55aff580ea02c02571a25d41.gif[/img]

Your ultimate goal is to discover the perfect combination of ingredients and price for every customer group in the city. This isn't as straightforward as you might think. The city's population has nine customer groups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/a748296a1807abaab54ddbbbb773bab360bab32d.gif[/img]

Each group is particular about how your business can provide services that match their lifestyle. For example, Students mainly prefer a cheap burger than one that is healthy or nutritious and expensive. Fit Ones on the other hand, care more about the burger's quality than it being relatively low cost.

After customers buy your burger, they give you feedback immediately about different aspects of your business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/4da71b9346b0517a73495d1d4622b7be64fd4523.gif[/img]

If your recipe and price perfectly match their taste and wallet, you get a perfect recipe feedback.

[b]A perfect [i]what[/i]?[/b] 🤣

Yep, a Perfect Recipe Feedback. You can track your recipe feedback from all the customer segments in the Perfect Recipe section.  Like all new product development efforts, you start with a blank slate, not knowing the exact combination of ingredients your target customer would love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/02aec06aecbd43624d639a12c96a1b467442cfd2.gif[/img]

Of course, all the customer segments will have their unique feedback on each recipe you put out because, as the popular saying goes, [i]One customer's food is another's poison[/i]. This is where product-market fit is key.

You can quickly see what each customer segment thinks of your burger recipe in the Perfect Recipe section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/fa909db5baa53e9fafcf4d0ecbb5cc1c6d47687f.gif[/img]

When you discover the perfect recipe for a customer group, the ingredient combination will be unlocked for that group.

A perfect burger for one segment could be a terrible burger or a burger with too much or too few ingredients for another segment. And so it goes until you conquer the city.

It's vital for customers to love your burgers because when they do, the feedback they give improves your business's reputation and helps you attract even more customers.

And that's it for this update. To get these updates delivered to you first, directly to your inbox, please [url=https://mailchi.mp/aeee9bdf2b69/join-us]join our community[/url]. We've got other exclusive perks waiting for you.

notes.title: Progress Update: Inventory Management and Automation
notes.notes:
Hello Business Heroes,

Welcome to our latest progress update. While we’ve been spending a tremendous amount of time just debugging the financials section😭, we still managed to get work done on the Inventory section for Burgers. Have a look.

[h1]Burger Inventory 🍔[/h1]

The Burger Inventory section is where you manage all the stock you need for your burgers - Buns, Patties, Tomatoes, Lettuce, Cheese, and Sauces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8707e546da1012ef476ec56bcc5a1e81d8e4550c.gif[/img]

A quick run down of the various sections:

[b]Stock (Total)[/b] - Helps you track how much of each ingredient you have left in stock and your new total (in brackets) after you make an order.

[b]Next Day’s Purchase Order[/b] - Where you order how much of each ingredient you need for the next business day.

[b]Burger Counter[/b] - Shows the number of burgers you can make with your current ingredient inventory size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/e9feca27e65e0ce147de4b9c49d458c533f1df3d.png[/img]

[i]Side Note: Whenever an ingredient is not enough for the number of buns you are ordering, the stock total stays red. It turns green when it’s enough.[/i]

[b]Daily Cost and Excess Loss[/b] - Daily cost is the amount your next day’s order costs. Excess loss is the cost of all wasted ingredients. Ingredients get wasted when you order after your storage is full.

[b]Storage Capacity[/b] - The brown bar represents how much storage your total stock has used up and how much is left.

[h1]Drinks 🥤[/h1]
The drinks on offer in the game are a combination of water, soda, and juice. They serve as a complementary product that your business may sell to customers to increase revenue. The inventory management for drinks works nearly the same way as that for burgers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/ff85f1ee2d41ca3720e4c376e47e78f940123af2.gif[/img]

Unlike burgers, however, drinks are not your business’s primary product. They require your food truck to be equipped with a cooler box or fridge before you can sell them. 

Depending on the type you own, you can equip your food truck with a cooler box or fridge by going to the add-ons section (where all the equipment upgrades are for your food truck are).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/7f04f66644e0235bbd075f1844432f6f0f4dd6bd.gif[/img]

[i]Side note: Upgrades that have the padlock symbol on them indicate that they are not compatible with your food truck.[/i] 

After equipping your food truck with a means of cold storage, you can begin to sell drinks to your customers. Notice in the image above that some fridges also increase the shelf life of burgers and ingredients. 

Be sure to keep an eye on your storage consumption, though. Drinks ordered after your cold storage is at full capacity will go to waste. And we certainly do not want that. 😉

[h1]Auto-stock 🤖[/h1]
Inventory management is one of the activities you will be carrying out daily to ensure you have enough stock for the next day. You will frequently have to increase or decrease your stock to avoid buying more or less than what you need. For Burger Inventory, this means managing quantities for all your ingredients individually.

As you expand, it’s only normal that you will want to automate your inventory process. We implemented a pay-per-use solution called Auto-stock to provide this automation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c20051566838d822f74451358e22ca6a74c2ab07.png[/img]

With one click, auto-stock helps you calculate the quantity of ingredients you require for the number of buns you have in stock. This way, you can quickly balance your order quantity across multiple stands, save time, and avoid overspending on inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/ff74dc26be84acfbe72761d16791c1f9828b38cd.gif[/img]

You will pay a fee every time you use the auto-stock function, so keep an eye on your account balance when you use it. If you are running low on cash, you can always manage your stock manually. 😊

After implementing this function, we were impressed with its impact on the gameplay experience. We are sure you’d appreciate the convenience it introduces to your business management activities when you can afford to use it.

Hi Business Heroes,

It's great to catch up with you again. We've been spending some time finishing up the game’s country selection system 🌎 and getting it to work properly.

[url=https://businessheroes.cool/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/CountrySelection.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/1f7d1757398dbe09f02452863c4b95e6f42d19ed.gif[/img][/url]
(click for higher resolution)

I can already hear you thinking, ‘I hope this is more than just an addition of different flags and currency symbols for aesthetics’.

It is 😁. The system contains the core economic mechanic of the game. In single player, you can start your business in any capital city of your choice. To change cities, you need to start a new game because each city has a different difficulty level. The difficulty level is based on, amongst other things, the price of raw materials🍅🥬🍞, the country’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP), and economic situation.

Economies around the world have business cycles consisting of periods of economic growth and downturn. Although a real-life cycle lasts an average of ten years, we limited it to a 1-year cycle in the game.

Some of the effects of the system on gameplay are:

- A difference in the price of raw materials from city to city.
- Changes in population spending pattern due to economic events.
- Changes in outdoor population size due to the current economic situation.

For example, your city’s population might reduce their spending because of a stock market crash 📉. Or they may increase their spending when the government implements fiscal stimulus 💵.

Also, the population has a base happiness level 🥳. Depending on the current economic situation, their happiness will either go up or down. When it goes up 🕺💃, more people are on the street, and you can make more profits during this period. When it goes down 😰, it gets more challenging for businesses.

As an astute entrepreneur, you should strategize your capital investment or loans to match current economic conditions. Sometimes, the only remedy is to have enough savings 💰 to go through hard cycles.

That’s it for today. Catch you later…

Live Long and Prosper 👋,

notes.title: Progress Update - Accessibility Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello Intending Business Heroes!

First of all, we would like to thank you all for wishlisting Business Heroes! Your interest in our game has been absolutely mindblowing. We wanted to share details of some of the improvements we are making to the game to make it more accessible to players with visual disabilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c31efbe7076f6ffb0cf1536777fa7eb76a036f84.jpg[/img]

Anyone with low vision or even someone just trying to play complex strategy games on a smaller pc screen will attest to the difficulty of seeing some game elements. Just like in the first version of our UI shown above, these games are particularly notorious for having smaller buttons and text because of the sheer amount of information that is usually being presented to the player.  Although Business Heroes is a business strategy game with a lot of embedded information, we still wanted players with vision-related challenges to have an enjoyable experience playing the game.

So, when the community alerted us to the problems with the initial colours, sizes, and contrasts we had used in the UI, we moved to fix them. 

[b]Larger Buttons and Text Sizes:[/b]
We started off by redesigning the button and text size to also work for players with impaired vision. We redesigned the UI layout to create more space for larger buttons, and we moved several components to a new window entirely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c236c4c2a651521616e10a31a18e0e283d641879.jpg[/img]

Making the text size work for everyone was a particularly tough nut to crack. We had to consider the impact language translation would have on the interface text and spacing. While we could not implement a solution that worked for all the text, we were able to allow players enlarge 90% of the game text to 24 points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/5aa0bdd6be00bbe53911904cfb2f0a2bab7ff11a.gif[/img]

[b]UI Colour Switcher and Icon Contrast:[/b]
Players with colour vision deficiency can switch the UI colour from yellow to dark blue depending on their visibility requirements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/b998f6238ba7609071ddcb4ead210764a1373dca.gif[/img]

We also needed to reduce the potential effect of the UI looking crowded due to too many colours. To do this, we kept inactive icons at 50% opacity by default. You can see their full colour when you place your mouse on them. We also included a function that allows you increase or decrease icon opacity as much as you like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/c88dcd350196022ab93d97bb4d118662f0ae43cd.gif[/img]

Plus, we also applied shapes to the different player colours to distinguish players and their competition. This way, players would not have to rely solely on colour to differentiate between other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/8ad81c29ecc8a48887b1b21118263d2c973412ce.png[/img]

[b]Game Music Controls:[/b]
One way we tried to cater to players with hearing symptoms is to give players control of the music volume in the game. We separated the music sound from the gameplay sound, so players can turn it down or turn it off completely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/fcb2dbf52f0410a2d21f4c5655ddd90268dd292d.gif[/img]

[b]Detailed Tooltips:[/b]
Finally, we also implemented a detailed tooltip and business guide feature. This is to make the game easier for non-gamers, new gamers, and teenagers in general. To prevent players from feeling overwhelmed with the UI, we included clear and concise explanations. All the player has to do is mouse over it and viola!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/0e24a7b5ac11086e6f5e873869e02b45fff48283.png[/img]

Many young people might be seeing the business terms and concepts in the game for the first time. We included a business guide that provides deeper insights into the meaning of the concepts and business terms used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39277006/11e950d60fffe5c935ed010a0e19d8a2e1222a94.png[/img]

We sincerely hope you enjoyed reading this as much as we enjoyed sharing it. We’d love to read your thoughts, so don’t hesitate to share. Thanks!
